title: AI Project Club
text: AI Project Club is a space to work on your project, get unstuck with AI, and build momentum with a community around you!

title: AI Project Club
text:
Who it is for?
This club is for those who create, build or do.
Are you currently:

writing, researching, designing, or creating content
testing a business or side-project idea
trying to use AI more effectively in your everyday workflow
looking for accountability and focused time to work

title: AI Project Club
text:
What happens in a meetup?

meet people (name badges provided!)
define your focus
work, work, work!
townhall

The meetup is not a silent space. We play background music to help with focus. Some tables are set up for collaboration, and others are set up for uninteruppted work.
The townhall brings the community together by creating space for:

optional sharing
questions
group support/feedback

title: AI Project Club
text:
What to bring?

a laptop
BYO AI: bring access to whichever AI tools you already use
a project, task, question, or idea
headphones if you like to focus quietly

title: AI Project Club
text:
Community expectations
Be friendly. Be curious. Get involved.
AI Project Club is a space to work, experiment, collaborate and have fun alongside others. Share ideas, ask questions, offer help and celebrate progress.
Respect other people’s ideas and privacy, share only what you are comfortable sharing, and use AI thoughtfully — especially with personal, private or sensitive information.
